name: White-Glazed Jar with Hidden Design
material: Porcelain with sweet-white (tianbai; 甜白) glaze
summary: White was a ritual color used in Buddhist ceremonies, as well as the color of mourning. This jar is made of two molded halves that were joined where the vessel’s middle section shows a raised line. It is covered by a silky white glaze called “sweet-white” (tianbai; 甜白). A “hidden design” (anhua; 暗花)
